title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1 to 2 years of experience in sales or business development, preferably in EdTech, SAAS or STEM publishing.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Please share your resume in English.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Especialista de Operações (Operations Specialist)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Execute and maintain operational workflows for cross-border payments (including fiat and stablecoin transactions) and VASP activities.
  • Monitor transaction costs, identify inefficiencies, and propose improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk controls, including KYB/KYC/AML checks, reporting, and audit readiness.
  • Coordinate with banking partners, OTC desks, and internal teams to guarantee smooth settlement, reconciliation, and liquidity management.
  • Develop and implement scalable SOPs and operational tools to support business growth, ensuring reliability and consistency across markets.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Job type: Full Time


Responsabilidades:

title: Nokia MPLS Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career! Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, thats why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


Key Responsibilities

· Design and implement MPLS networks using Nokia 7750 SR and 7705 SAR platforms.

· Configure and maintain DWDM/OTN systems using Nokia 1830 PSS.

· Perform network provisioning, testing, and troubleshooting across IP and optical layers.

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support network migrations from legacy SONET/TDM to MPLS/DWDM.

· Monitor network performance and optimize routing and wavelength assignments.

· Maintain and update network documentation and configuration standards.

· Interface with Nokia support and vendors for escalations and firmware upgrades.


Required Skills & Qualifications

· Strong hands-on experience with Nokia IP/MPLS platforms (7750 SR, 7705 SAR).

· Deep understanding of DWDM, OTN, and optical transport technologies.

· Familiarity with routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, IS-IS, RSVP-TE, Segment Routing).

· Experience with network management tools like Nokia NSP (Network Services Platform).

· Proficiency in troubleshooting tools (OTDR, spectrum analyzers, Wireshark).

· Certifications such as NRS I/II (Nokia Network Routing Specialist) are a plus.

· Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or related field.


What do we offer? TCS Benefits – Brazil:


  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. title: Analytics Architect - Azure
description:
Job Title: Analytics Architect

Location: Remote

Duration: Contract

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Analytics Architect to lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics and big data solutions on the Azure platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in Azure Databricks/Fabric, big data technologies, and cloud-based data engineering, with a proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable analytics solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and IT teams to gather requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
  • Oversee end-to-end implementation of data platforms, ensuring alignment with business needs and industry best practices.
  • Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes using Azure Databricks, PySpark, and related tools.
  • Integrate Azure Databricks with Azure services such as Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, and on-premise systems.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineers and developers.
  • Ensure documentation of architectures, processes, and data flows.
  • Enforce best practices for code quality, performance, scalability, data security, and governance.
  • Stay current with emerging Databricks and Azure analytics technologies to drive innovation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks (cluster management, notebooks, Delta Lake).
  • Proficiency in big data technologies such as Spark and Hadoop.
  • Strong experience with PySpark and SQL.
  • Deep knowledge of Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Data Factory.
  • Experience with data warehousing, data lakes, and ETL/ELT architectures.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, SSRS, and SSAS.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control tools (Git).
  • Knowledge of cloud security, data governance, and compliance best practices.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a senior-level Full-Stack PHP Developer who thrives on solving real problems, takes full ownership of systems, and communicates clearly and thoroughly. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys digging into existing applications, understanding how they actually work, and improving them with pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions.

You’ll work on production SaaS systems built primarily on PHP 8 and CodeIgniter , spanning application logic, data modeling, and frontend integration. We value engineers who think end-to-end, explain their reasoning, and treat the product as if they own it.


What You’ll Do

  • Own application features and fixes from start to finish — from investigation and design through implementation and rollout
  • Deep-dive into existing PHP/CodeIgniter codebases to debug issues, improve reliability, and reduce technical debt
  • Design and implement new features with attention to maintainability, performance, and clarity
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering peers, clearly explaining tradeoffs, risks, and decisions
  • Improve application architecture incrementally (schemas, services, controllers, APIs)
  • Participate in production issue triage and root-cause analysis when needed
  • Proactively identify improvements rather than waiting for tickets


Core Technical Requirements

  • Strong experience with PHP 8 in production environments
  • Hands-on experience with CodeIgniter (or deep familiarity with similar MVC PHP frameworks)
  • Solid background in LAMP-style stacks (Linux, MySQL/MariaDB, PHP, Apache/Nginx)
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Comfortable working across backend and frontend boundaries
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, AJAX, and modern browser behavior
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing/debugging relational schemas


Nice-to-Have (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with Redis, Elasticsearch, or similar data stores
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, basic DevOps workflows, or cloud hosting (AWS/GCP/etc.)
  • Experience modernizing legacy PHP applications
  • Familiarity with containerized or service-oriented deployments


What We Care About Most

  • Ownership mentality — you don’t just “complete tasks,” you take responsibility for outcomes
  • Problem-solving depth — you like understanding why something broke, not just patching it
  • Verbose, clear communication — you explain your thinking, document decisions, and surface risks early
  • Comfort working independently without constant oversight
  • Strong judgment when balancing speed vs. correctness


Experience Level

  • 5+ years professional experience building and maintaining PHP applications
  • Proven track record working in real production systems (not just greenfield demos)


Working Environment

  • Results-focused culture: outcomes matter more than hours
  • Remote-friendly, globally distributed team
  • High trust, low micromanagement
  • Direct access to decision-makers and real influence over technical direction


Why This Role

  • Real systems, real users, real problems
  • Autonomy to improve code and architecture meaningfully
  • Opportunity to be a true owner , not a ticket-taker
  • Competitive compensation with room for growth

title: Product Owner
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


About This Opportunity

As a Product Owner, you will work closely with both our Business Intelligence and Reporting Teams. In this position you will be accountable to manage data and reporting requirements to fulfill stakeholder or customer requests. You will also lead the roadmap and requirements analysis primarily for our financial systems.


The ideal candidate will have experience with Scrum/ Agile processes, Accounting/Financial Systems, SSRS, PowerBI, and Tableau. Knowledge of ETL and Oracle/Oracle EBS is a plus.


Professional English Language skills are required.


Position is CLT and fully remote (must reside in Brazil). Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for Internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!



Responsibilities

  • Work directly with Finance & Accounting leadership and BI teams on product backlog and coordinate with various technology teams across InComm to implement new solutions.
  • Build, manage and prioritize product backlog based on the overall strategy and business objectives for future product development.
  • Responsible for creating and/or managing following artifacts:

-Road Map

-Development Backlog

-User Stories and Sprint Tasks

-Supporting documents for user stories


  • Monitor and Review ServiceNow (SNOW) requests
  • Create product vision and roadmap which accomplishes the goal of the vision and convey that vision to the scrum team.
  • Ensure user stories are well defined and ready for development to begin.
  • Responsible for optimizing the value of the work done.
  • Accountable for each stage of the development process and the final product.
  • Ensure close collaboration with development team. Be available to address any questions team members have regarding requirements or implementation of a product feature.
  • Responsible for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including product managers, leadership, customers, and the development team to make sure their vision is aligned with business objectives.


Preferred Qualifications/Experience:

  • Experience with reporting and operations within Billing, Accounting, and Sales
  • Experience working in Agile/Technical environments
  • Skilled in and comfortable working alongside technical stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, actionable inputs for development or support teams.
  • Proficient in Agile/Scrum
  • Agile/Scrum Certification
  • General knowledge of ERP, Databases (Oracle & MS SQL) and DataLakesis a plus
  • SRS, PowerBI, and Tableau and knowledge of ETL.


InComm provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin, citizenship, veteran’s status, age, disability status, genetics or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

A large pharmaceutical client is looking for a Business Analyst to join their team. This person will be working on a data connector project from Veeva Quality to Veeva RIM. They will be responsible for meeting with the business stakeholders across Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing & Supply Chain to understand business requirements and write user documents. They will be acting as a liaison between the business and the technical Veeva teams. They will also be interfacing with the validation team to understand the records in the system, write the data plan and relay that to the technical team. This resource must have prior pharma experience and be comfortable speaking with both technical and business teams. This is a remote opportunity in LATAM.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

- 5-7 Years of Experience as a Business Analyst - Pharma and Manufacturing experience - Knowledge of supply chain, quality and manufacturing - 1-2 years of Veeva Quality knowledge - Strong written and verbal communication skills - Knowledge of SAP ERP Systems

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • - Regulatory experience - Veeva RIM experience

Compensation :

$17-$19/ hr USD

Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Benefit packages for this role will start on the 31st day of employment and include medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as HSA, FSA, and DCFSA account options, and 401k retirement account access with employer matching. Employees in this role are also entitled to paid sick leave and/or other paid time off as provided by applicable law.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer for a 100% Remote, 6 month +, 1099 contract


No 3rd Party C2Cs Please.


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


100% Requirement: Must have good verbal & written communication (English)


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer IV to lead technical initiatives, tackle complex engineering challenges, and provide mentorship to the team. This role requires expertise in software development, leadership in driving projects, and the ability to design scalable solutions. The ideal candidate will manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.


In This Role You Will:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver project requirements
  • Ensure engineering best practices are followed throughout development
  • Contribute to system architecture and design discussions


Core Competencies for success:

  • Expertise in at least one critical system/service and recognized leadership in that area
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions
  • Ability to estimate project costs and resource needs
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills
  • Commitment to continuous learning and innovation


Requirements:

  • Preference for engineers with full-stack proficiency, particularly in Vue.js
  • Proficiency in backend development using Python, SQL, MongoDB and AWS
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable software solutions
  • Strong expertise in software development methodologies and best practices
  • Experience leading teams and managing software projects

title: Site Reliability Engineer - (SRE / DevOps) – Azure
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Você será parte de uma equipe de alta performance focada em garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura em nuvem global da empresa, com foco em Microsoft Azure . Atuará em um ambiente dinâmico, com equilíbrio entre projetos estratégicos em sprints quinzenais e suporte contínuo à infraestrutura produtiva , garantindo alta disponibilidade e segurança dos sistemas críticos.

Se você é apaixonado por automação, observabilidade, arquitetura em nuvem e tem experiência sólida em infraestrutura como código, esta é uma oportunidade para impactar diretamente na transformação digital de grandes clientes do mercado.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar, analisar e otimizar o desempenho da infraestrutura em Microsoft Azure (clusters, redes, serviços de dados e aplicações).
  • Desenvolver, manter e escalar infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform em ambientes multi-região.
  • Gerenciar e evoluir pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps Pipelines e GitHub Actions , garantindo entregas rápidas e seguras.
  • Atuar no ciclo de incidentes em produção , incluindo triagem, análise de causa raiz (Root Cause Analysis), documentação e implementação de correções preventivas.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para otimizar arquiteturas em nuvem , promovendo melhores práticas de escalabilidade, segurança e custo.
  • Administrar e monitorar serviços críticos como Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Data Factory, App Services, API Management, Application Gateway e redes privadas (VNet, ExpressRoute) .
  • Gerenciar e integrar soluções de observabilidade com Datadog , criando dashboards personalizados, alertas e métricas para clusters e serviços em Azure.
  • Apoiar a gestão de dados em Databricks , garantindo integridade, performance e segurança dos pipelines de dados.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Microsoft Azure (AKS, Azure Data Factory, App Services, API Management, Application Gateway, Networking).
  • Proficiência em Terraform para provisionamento e gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem.
  • Experiência prática com CI/CD usando Azure DevOps Pipelines e GitHub Actions .
  • Conhecimento avançado em observabilidade com Datadog (criação de dashboards, alertas, monitoramento de clusters).
  • Experiência com Databricks e processos de data engineering em nuvem.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ciclo de incidentes com foco em resolução rápida e prevenção de recorrência.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente (leitura, escrita e comunicação oral) – necessário para colaboração com times globais.


Benefícios e Cultura

  • Ambiente colaborativo, inovador e com foco em crescimento profissional.
  • Flexibilidade de horários e trabalho remoto.
  • Programa de capacitação contínua (cursos, certificações, eventos).
  • Participação em projetos estratégicos com impacto real no negócio.
  • Integração com o Mantu Group , rede de empresas de tecnologia e consultoria com presença global.

title: Android Developer (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).

What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.

What makes us different?

title: Sports Reporter
description:
Estamos buscando entusiastas do esporte que residam perto dos estados abaixo para se juntarem à nossa equipe como coletores de dados para eventos de futebol. A missão do repórter é coletar dados estatísticos ao vivo nos locais dos jogos, por meio do nosso aplicativo para dispositivos Android e iPhone.


Qualificações e Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento básico de inglês
  • Possuir um dispositivo Android/iPhone
  • Concluir um treinamento online para aprender a trabalhar com o aplicativo móvel
  • Não é necessário ter formação em jornalismo


Local de trabalho: Estádios de futebol e outros locais esportivos


Oferecemos:

  • Trabalho perfeito para estudantes ou para complementar a renda
  • Treinamento completo e gratuito
  • 62 euros (aproximadamente 405 reais) por partida coberta, além de reembolso de despesas de viagem e ingressos


Estados onde precisamos urgentemente de pessoas para coleta de dados nos locais dos jogos:

  • Alagoas
  • Amazônia
  • Espírito Santo
  • Goiás
  • Maranhão
  • Mato Grosso/Mato Grosso do Sul
  • Pará
  • Paraíba
  • Piauí
  • Rondônia
  • Roraima

title: IT Service Desk - Advanced English
description:
What a day in the life looks like:

  • Provide frontline support via phone and ticketing systems to resolve software-related issues.
  • Gather key details to assess and triage cases to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Maintain accurate, detailed documentation within the ticketing system.
  • Ensure timely responses and resolutions in line with defined SLAs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and partners to drive case resolution.
  • Use empathy, active listening, and emotional intelligence to ensure excellent customer experiences.

What you bring to the team:

  • BA/BS Degree, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent.
  • 3 years of technical customer support experience.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English.
  • Experience or industry knowledge in supply chain software such as warehouse management solutions or order/ inventory management solutions.
  • Experience in database (SQL / Oracle) queries and stored procedures.
  • Experience with operating systems and RF hardware.
  • Experience with labeling software (e.g., Bartender) and voice solutions such as Honeywell is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow or other industry-standard ticketing systems is preferred.
  • Fluency in English. Mandatory

You Are Skilled With And Have Significant Experience With

  • Supply chain and distribution industry knowledge and experience.
  • Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) expertise in RedPrairie (JDA), Manhattan Associates, SAP- WM, Oracle-WM, Accellos, Infor, etc.
  • Barcode scanning and RF hardware (Intermec, LXE, Motorola, Symbol)
  • Labeling (Bartender or Loftware) experience a plus
  • Reporting (Cognos, Business Objects, SSRS) experience a plus
  • Networking (Cisco, WAN/LAN, troubleshooting)

title: Analista de Tools
description:
Analista de Tools Pleno


Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


• Implementar, administrar e dar suporte a ambientes de Zabbix, Grafana e Ansible, garantindo a correta coleta, análise e visualização de métricas.

• Desenvolver e manter integrações entre sistemas de monitoramento, automação e plataformas corporativas, seguindo padrões definidos pelo time.

• Apoiar a administração e otimização de bancos de dados PostgreSQL, incluindo rotinas básicas de tuning, replicação e manutenção.

• Monitorar logs e eventos relevantes utilizando Syslog, Elastic Stack ou ferramentas equivalentes.

• Atuar na resolução de incidentes relacionados às ferramentas de monitoramento e automação.

• Contribuir com melhorias contínuas, automações e padronizações que elevem a maturidade operacional do ambiente.

• Produzir e manter documentação técnica das soluções implementadas.

Requisitos e qualificações

• Experiência em ambientes de infraestrutura, monitoramento ou operações.

• Conhecimento em protocolos de rede e comunicação (SNMP, ICMP, HTTP, SSH, API REST, Syslog).

• Experiência prática com Zabbix, Grafana, Ansible, PostgreSQL e Linux.

• Noções de arquiteturas distribuídas e ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

• Experiência com integrações via API e troubleshooting em ambientes híbridos.

• Conhecimento básico ou intermediário em ambientes Azure.

• Familiaridade com versionamento de código e automações utilizando Git/GitLab CI/CD.

Certificações desejáveis:

• Zabbix Certified User (ZCU) ou Zabbix Certified Specialist (ZCS)

• Certificações iniciais em Cloud (Azure Fundamentals ou similares)

• LPIC-1 ou equivalente

Diferenciais Desejáveis

• Experiência ou contato com Elastic Stack, NetBox, APM ou ferramentas correlatas.

• Conhecimentos em Python, Bash ou JavaScript para automações e scripts.

• Atuação prévia em times de Tools, NOC, SRE ou DevOps.

• Interesse em automação, confiabilidade e melhoria contínua (Kaizen).


Informações adicionais

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Devops Engineer (Projeto Internacional)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com DevOps atuando com Saas/PaaS e plataformas de serviços;
  • Experiência com CI/CD, plataforma Azure (Kubernetes / SQL / AppGW / Key Vault);
  • Experiência com Jira e distribuição Linux;
  • Experiência com suporte operacional por meio de solução de problemas e análise de erros, garantindo o registro e monitoramento eficientes e solução de problemas confiável;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por provisionar, configurar e manter ambientes em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas (principalmente plataforma Azure) para garantir escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

Além disso, é essencial o domínio em administração de sistemas Linux, com conhecimento em roteamento, estratégias de firewall e gestão de certificados. O profissional também atuará no suporte operacional, realizando análises de erros e troubleshooting, assegurando que os ambientes estejam corretamente logados, monitorados e performando de forma eficiente. Ter conhecimento ou interesse em práticas de CI/CD é valorizado, assim como disposição para trabalhar com ferramentas colaborativas como SharePoint e Jira.

Buscamos alguém com perfil proativo, analítico e orientado à automação, que contribua ativamente para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da infraestrutura


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Operations Analytics
description:
We're looking for a Operations Analytics 100% remote in Brazil


Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced Operations Analytics professional to deliver high-impact insights that support our end-to-end operations. In this role, you will work closely with teams across inventory, logistics, retail, and customer service, while partnering with technology and finance stakeholders. You’ll engage with nearly all aspects of a growing business to measure performance, identify opportunities, and drive alignment toward the most impactful operational improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze, understand, and quantify key operational efficiency metrics.
  • Design, implement, and report on item-level data throughout receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows.
  • Provide daily reporting and product-health measurements to support business decision-making.
  • Communicate insights clearly and effectively to partner teams and leadership.
  • Collaborate with operations analysts to optimize processes and uncover opportunities for growth.


Minimum Requirements:

  • 5+ years of analytics experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency in SQL.
  • 5+ years working with BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Looker, etc.
  • Strong ability to translate practical business problems into technical solutions.
  • Proven experience delivering time-sensitive strategic projects involving methodology development, analysis, recommendations, and executive presentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguous environments.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in eCommerce or logistics industries.

title: Data Quality Analyst Senior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Definir, monitorar e otimizar processos de qualidade de dados.
  • Garantir a adoção das melhores práticas em qualidade de dados em todas as plataformas do cliente.
  • Liderar a equipe de qualidade de dados, orientando e capacitando os membros.
  • Criar e manter dashboards de qualidade de dados, monitorando KPIs em tempo real (completude, consistência, conformidade, integridade e unicidade).
  • Interagir com diferentes stakeholders, desde equipes técnicas até áreas de negócios, para garantir que os dados suportem decisões estratégicas e operacionais.
  • Implementar soluções eficazes para detecção e remediação de problemas de qualidade de dados.
  • Apoiar a evolução das estratégias de qualidade de dados da empresa, promovendo uma cultura baseada em dados confiáveis.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação Superior Completa em Análise de Sistemas, Ciências da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Gestão de Tecnologia da Informação e/ou áreas afins.
  • Conhecimento sólido em metodologias de qualidade de dados (como DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Capacidade de analisar requisitos de negócio e traduzir necessidades em regras de qualidade de dados.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para interagir com diferentes stakeholders.
  • Perfil colaborativo, com mentalidade de resolução de problemas e inovação.
  • Experiência em definição e monitoramento de indicadores de qualidade de dados (completude, consistência, conformidade, unicidade e integridade).
  • Experiência em liderança técnica, mentoria e capacitação de times de dados.
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão e qualidade de dados, governança de dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de qualidade de dados (Great Expectations, Informatica Data Quality, Talend, Collibra ou similares).
  • Experiência com SQL para análise e manipulação de dados.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Data Visualization (Power BI) para criação de dashboards e relatórios sobre qualidade de dados.
  • Desejável conhecimento de serviços cloud e arquitetura de software (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud).



Diferenciais:

  • (Conhecimento e/ou experiência em metodologias ágeis (como SAFe).
  • Vivência em projetos de migração de dados e gestão de metadados.
  • Experiência com Data Observability e automação de monitoramento de qualidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning e DataOps aplicados à qualidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e estruturação de dicionários de dados.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de conformidade regulatória (como LGPD).
  • Noções de Python ou R para análise e manipulação avançada de dados.

Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações Java,
  • Criação de serviços web (RESTful API);
  • Desenvolvimento Angular / TypeScript / Javascript / CSS / HTML;
  • Desenvolvimento Spring e JPA;
  • Desenvolvimento de Projetos utilizando metodologias ágeis.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Desenvolvimento de aplicações Java, criação de serviços web (RESTful API);
  • Desenvolvimento Angular / TypeScript / Javascript / CSS / HTML;
  • Desenvolvimento Spring e JPA; - Desenvolvimento de Projetos utilizando metodologias ágeis;
  • Banco de dados relacional (Oracle, SQL Server);
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de testes unitários automáticos;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Docker, Kubernetes, microserviços;
  • Conhecimento em Kafka;
  • Conhecimento em Keycloak;
  • Conhecimento em Linux.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica
